items.Sentence: Raw wastewater enters the Facility by way of two grinder pumps.
From the headworks, influent enters the primary clarifier in the center and is directed towards the bottoms of the tank by use of a stilling baffle.
Effluent from primary clarifier is fed by gravity into a fixed film reactor sump, where it is then pumped over the fixed film reactor along with a percentage of recirculation water.
An additional recirculation pump has been installed to re-circulate secondary effluent to the Fixed Film Reactor.
Effluent from the fixed film reactor enters a sump that partially recirculates back to the fixed film reactor, while the remainder is pumped to two secondary sedimentation tanks.
Effluent from the secondary sedimentation tanks is disinfected with sodium hypochlorite and then dechlorinated with sodium bisulfite.

Biosolids from the secondary sedimentation tanks are collected and pumped back to the primary clarifier and ultimately to the anaerobic digester.

Biosolids that are collected and pumped to the anaerobic digester are disposed of by pumping the solids directly from the bottom of the digester through a 3- inch cam fitting and trucking the material off-site for further processing.
